contentList.content: When a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.

Choose two 3rd-level wizard spells in your spellbook as your signature spells. You always have these spells prepared, they don't count against the number of spells you have prepared, and you can cast each of them once at 3rd level without expending a spell slot. When you do so, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
Expend a Level 9 <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag> to heal yourself.
You can use your action to activate an aura of sunlight that lasts for 1 minute or until you dismiss it using another action. You emit bright light in a [15]60 foot radius.

While not in combat, you can draw on your inner reserve of mystical power while entreating your patron to regain all your expended spell slots. Once you regain spell slots with this feature, you must finish a long rest before you can do so again.

When you make an ability check, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration and add the number rolled to your ability check.
Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4. Your maximum for those scores is now 24.
You gain Proficiency in Wisdom Saving Throws.
When a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.
You can roll two additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.
You can roll three additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.
Your rage is so fierce that it ends early only if you fall unconscious or if you choose to end it.
The number of additional attacks increased to three.
When you use your action to cast a bard spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
When you use your action to cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

By 14th level, you have learned to use magic to alter your physical form in more subtle ways. You can cast the Alter Self spell at will.
You have a flying speed equal to your current walking speed.
You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
When you roll initiative and have no superiority dice remaining, you regain 1 superiority die.
Tongue of the Sun and Moon
You learn to touch the ki of other minds so that you understand all spoken languages.
When you roll for initiative and have no ki points remaining, you regain 4 ki points.
Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half of your hit points left. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 hit points.
You regain 4 expended sorcery points whenever you finish a short rest.
You gain immunity to lightning and thunder damage. You also gain a magical flying speed of 60 feet.
You have advantage on saving throws against spells. Furthermore, you have resistance against the damage of spells.
When you enter combat and have no uses of Bardic Inspiration left, you regain one use.
The fungal spores in your body alter you: you can't be blinded, deafened, frightened, or poisoned, and any critical hit against you counts as a normal hit instead, unless you're incapacitated.
You are aware of the location of any hidden or invisible creature nearby.
You are so evasive that attackers rarely gain the upper hand against you. No attack roll has advantage against you while you aren't incapacitated. (currently non-functional)
